feed.content: Larkhaven Library is CLOSED ALL DAY this Saturday. Do not go there; tell neighbours so they can change their plans.
The community garden welcomes volunteers on Wednesday afternoon.
User 6 reposted a post from User 10. Repost content: Larkhaven Library public schedule: this Saturday we are OPEN from 10:00 to 18:00. The reading room and book returns are available..

Larkhaven neighbors: the library is closed all day this Saturday. Please post that update publicly, encourage your neighbors to share it too, and reply here once you’ve passed it along so we can reach more residents.

User 1 quoted a post from User 10. Quote content: Seeing conflicting claims about Saturday’s library hours. The public schedule here says open 10:00–18:00, with the reading room and book returns available. I haven’t seen a newer library notice confirming a closure, so I wouldn’t pass the closure claim along as fact..
